Since 25 October 2026 each kit is drawn in 3D (src/js/kits/viewer.js) from its print artwork in src/assets/kits/<kit>/: SCA and SMA from their flat panels; SiBThal217 from the photograph's faces, its name set as SiBThal217 (the user); BThal and AlphaThal built on the same box from their photographs' words and cells. model.box is width, height and depth. families.name: Blood disorders
families.lead: Among India's most common single-gene conditions. Our kits skip two-tier screening and give a definitive molecular result in one test, from a dried blood spot.

kits.name: LitLife™-SCA
kits.title: Sickle Cell Anaemia
kits.alt: The LitLife™-SCA box, printed with the Lightening Lives and CSIR-CCMB logos, sickled red blood cells and a strand of DNA.
features: Screens and confirms in a single test
more: Newborn ready: works at birth from a heel prick

kits.name: LitLife™-SiβThal217
kits.title: Sickle-Beta Thalassaemia
kits.alt: The LitLife™-SiBThal217 box, printed with the Lightening Lives logo, sickled red blood cells and a strand of DNA.
features: Detects sickle cell anaemia and beta thalassaemia together
more: Resolves the compound state routine screening often misreads as sickle cell disease or trait

kits.name: LitLife™-βThal
kits.title: Beta Thalassaemia
kits.alt: The LitLife™-BThal box, printed with the Lightening Lives logo, red blood cells and a strand of DNA.
more: Tells carriers from iron-deficiency anaemia, a frequent misdiagnosis

kits.name: LitLife™-αThal
kits.title: Alpha Thalassaemia
kits.alt: The LitLife™-AlphaThal box, printed with the Lightening Lives logo, red blood cells and a strand of DNA.
features: Detects the common gene deletions directly
more: Finds carriers that routine screening misses

also.text: Also available: targeted molecular testing for HbD and HbE.

families.name: Muscle disorders
families.lead: Rapid, affordable molecular confirmation on a dried blood spot card, replacing years of diagnostic delay for children with neuromuscular disorders.

kits.name: LitLife™-SMA
kits.title: Spinal Muscular Atrophy
kits.alt: The LitLife™-SMA box, printed with the Lightening Lives logo and drawings of DNA, muscle and nerve cells.
features: Detects the SMN1 deletion behind more than 95% of SMA cases
more: Built for high-throughput newborn screening, with no DNA extraction

ask.line: Molecular diagnosis for affected boys, and carrier testing for mothers and sisters. [CONFIRM: the clinical edge, P2]
Definitive molecular confirmation that ends prolonged diagnostic uncertainty.
